title: Use the official signed Open Design app as the bundled headless owner

supersedes.assumption: The Open Design Resources tree can be launched by passing app/main.cjs to the packaged Hermes Electron executable.
supersedes.scope: Packaging and top-level headless launch mechanism only

evidence.description: Launching the packaged Hermes executable with Open Design app/main.cjs and --headless booted Hermes itself, emitted the Hermes install stamp, exited without an Open Design identity, and never served Open Design.
The checksum-pinned Open Design 0.20.0 macOS release Resources tree contains no plain-Node headless bundle that can preserve the official packaged lifecycle under ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE.

The checksum-pinned signed Open Design 0.20.0 executable launched with --headless in a disposable namespace, returned /api/health version 0.20.0, exposed Hermes as available with 73 models, created no BrowserWindow, and removed owned parent and child processes on SIGTERM.

decision.bundle: Stage the complete official signed Open Design.app on macOS under open-design-runtime/Open Design.app. Stage the equivalent official installed application payload on Windows.
decision.launch: Spawn the bundled or compatible installed Open Design executable with the single --headless argument and a Hermes-generated no-telemetry config in an allowlisted environment.
decision.ownership: Open Design remains the top-level owner of its daemon and web sidecars; Hermes owns only the headless application process it spawned.
decision.gitPolicy: No Open Design installer or application bytes are committed to Git. The official checksum-pinned asset is staged only during packaging into ignored build output.

unchangedInvariants: Open Design 0.20.0 tag, commit, asset name, and SHA-256 remain pinned.
No provider credential is copied into Open Design configuration or IPC.
HERMES_BIN and profile-scoped HERMES_HOME are the only Hermes credential/model handoff.
The headless runtime uses a Hermes-owned profile namespace and data root.
OD-02 through OD-13 acceptance behavior remains unchanged.
A packaged Hermes smoke must pass after the external /Applications/Open Design.app is temporarily moved out of discovery scope.

rejectedAlternative.name: Reimplement Open Design sidecar lifecycle from daemon-sidecar.mjs and web-sidecar.mjs
rejectedAlternative.reason: It would duplicate Open Design's IPC ownership, stale-instance retirement, restart, update, and shutdown semantics and create a larger long-term compatibility surface than staging the official signed headless owner.
